workflow.critical: Communicate in {communication_language}. One bug per run. Reproduce before fixing. Smallest fix. Never mark Fixed without verification evidence.

step.action: If config worktree_isolation is not false: follow Phase A of {project-root}/AI-QA-FRAMEWORK/rules/worktree-isolation.md — create branch + git worktree, work only inside it (switch app port per Phase A step 6). Whole command runs inside it
Bug file = command argument; if none, read {output_folder}/test-results/bugs/BUGS-INDEX.md and ask which Open bug to fix
Reproduction browser is visible unless the user asked for headless

step.output: Status, root cause, files changed, verification, review result (found / fixed / open), commit id. Then the final line (Next Step is : <next command>).

step.action: After the review pass: follow Phase B (stop app, reset port to the base value, verify, commit on the sub-branch) and Phase C of {project-root}/AI-QA-FRAMEWORK/rules/worktree-isolation.md. Ask the user to commit/push/merge to the base branch and remove the sub-branch; never do it unasked
step.output: The LAST line of the response is: (Next Step is : <next command>) — see "Next-step line" in the rule file. Nothing after it
